A named font file included in a **Deck App Package** and declared by the **Deck App Package Manifest** for author code to reference. Characters a TrueType or OpenType **Deck App Font** lacks render from the **Runtime Default Font**; `.fnt` and `.bdf` fonts do not fall back. Emoji in text drawn with a TrueType or OpenType font render as colour Twemoji images that ship with VitaDeck, not from either font; an emoji without an image, as in a build that could not download them, draws its first character from those fonts, or `U+FFFD` when neither has it. `.fnt` and `.bdf` fonts draw no emoji.

lines.text: Text, Button and TextInput take any `fontSize` in pixels, and text is UTF-8. Without `font` they use the runtime's DejaVu Sans. Characters a `.ttf` or `.otf` font lacks render in DejaVu Sans; a character neither has renders as a box. `.fnt` and `.bdf` fonts have no fallback.

Emoji render in colour, sized to `fontSize`, from the [Twemoji](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji) images (CC-BY 4.0) that ship with VitaDeck. Single emoji, emoji with `U+FE0F`, skin tones, flags and keycaps work. A ZWJ sequence Twemoji has no image for draws as its first emoji, and a symbol such as `❤` without `U+FE0F` stays a font glyph. `.fnt` and `.bdf` fonts draw no emoji.
### TypeScript
Extend the SDK preset and include the generated types:
- `git submodule update --init --recursive` if `vendor/quickjs/quickjs.c` is missing.

- Host build needs CMake, raylib 5.5, curl, OpenSSL, zlib (`brew install raylib` on macOS; raylib + OpenGL/X11 dev packages on Linux). On Linux/GCC configure with `CC=gcc CXX=g++ cmake -S . -B out -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group"`.
- Vita build and Linux smoke run in Docker. Start Docker Desktop first.

- The first CMake configure downloads the pinned Twemoji images ([cmake/twemoji.cmake](cmake/twemoji.cmake)) into the gitignored `assets/emoji/`; without network it warns, builds anyway, emoji draw a fallback glyph, and the next configure retries.
- Uploading a Vita build (`upload_vita`, `upload_vpk`, `run`) reads the Vita's IP from `PSVITAIP` when CMake configures, e.g. `export PSVITAIP=192.168.1.177`.
- Releases: [docs/releasing.md](docs/releasing.md).
**Host (current machine)** — e.g. macOS:
- CMake 3.10+
- CMake 3.18+ (older versions build without the Twemoji images)
- [raylib](https://www.raylib.com/) via Homebrew: `brew install raylib`
- CURL, OpenSSL, and zlib (typical on macOS; CMake `find_package` must succeed)

lines.text: ## Notes

- Configure downloads the pinned Twemoji release once into the gitignored `assets/emoji/` (`cmake/twemoji.cmake`, SHA-256 checked); host and VPK builds both ship that folder. Without network it warns, emoji draw a fallback glyph, and the next configure retries.
- In the container, `VITASDK` is set by the image; the project picks the Vita toolchain when that env var is present.
- Host builds use `out/`; Vita builds use `out-vita/` on the **host** filesystem (bind-mounted from the container).

- Host only: `cmake --build out --target stage_examples` copies every built `js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp` into `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps`; `cmake --build out --target run` builds, stages, and launches `out/vitadeck`.
